meta.status: Approved for development. Use these strings as written.
rules: Sentence case everywhere. No Title Case, no ALL CAPS.
Plain English. Say what happens, not how the system is built.
Placeholders use {curly_braces}. Never translate or rename placeholders.
Wrap every string in the plugin text domain for translation.
Never use the words 'blazing', 'lightning', 'ultimate', 'magic', or a promised score.
Errors say what went wrong and what to do next. No apologies.

navigation.section_intro: Saves a ready-made copy of each page so visitors get it without waiting for WordPress to build it. Logged-in users, carts, checkouts and forms are always handled safely.

on.label: On
on.text: UiChemy is caching pages for logged-out visitors.

host.label: Handled by {host}
host.text: {host} already caches your pages, so UiChemy's cache is off to avoid conflicts. UiChemy clears the {host} cache when you save a page.
host.text_no_purge: {host} already caches your pages, so UiChemy's cache is off to avoid conflicts. {host} clears its own cache; UiChemy can't do it for you on this host.

other_plugin.label: Handled by {plugin}
other_plugin.text: {plugin} is already caching your pages. To use UiChemy's cache instead, turn off page caching in {plugin} first.

off.label: Off
off.text: Pages are built fresh for every visitor.

unavailable.label: Not available
unavailable.text: Page cache can't run on this site: {reason}

needs_setup.label: One step left
needs_setup.text: UiChemy can't edit wp-config.php on this server. Add the line below to turn the cache on.

controls.label: Cache pages

choices.label: Automatic
choices.hint: UiChemy checks your hosting and picks the safe option.

choices.label: UiChemy cache
choices.hint: Cache pages with UiChemy, even if your host has its own cache.

choices.label: My host's cache
choices.hint: Keep UiChemy's cache off. UiChemy still clears your host's cache when you save.

controls.help: Turn it on and UiChemy checks your hosting, sets it up and tests your home page.
controls.tooltip: A page cache saves the finished HTML of a page. The next visitor gets that copy straight away, without WordPress loading your theme, plugins and database.
controls.warning_on_uichemy_with_host: Your host already caches pages. Running two caches can show visitors old content. Continue only if your host's support has told you to.
controls.ai_description: Selects who caches full pages. 'auto' resolves to 'uichemy' when no host or plugin page cache is detected with grade A evidence, otherwise to 'host'.

controls.label: Refresh pages every
controls.help: Forms use security tokens that WordPress expires after 12 to 24 hours, so 10 hours is the longest we allow.
controls.tooltip: Forms on your pages use security tokens that WordPress expires after 12 to 24 hours. Refreshing within 10 hours keeps every form working. A shorter time only helps if your pages show time-based content, such as a countdown or a 'latest posts' list from another site.
controls.ai_description: Maximum age of a cached page. Hard maximum 10h; values above are rejected with 'invalid_value'.

controls.label: Separate copy for mobile
controls.help: Turn this on only if your theme or another plugin shows different HTML on phones.
controls.tooltip: Pages built with UiChemy use the same HTML on every device and adapt with CSS, so one copy is enough. Some themes and plugins send different HTML to phones; for those, keep a separate mobile copy.
controls.ai_description: Adds device class (mobile/desktop) to the cache key. Doubles stored files.

controls.type: tag field: pages (shown as their paths) and paths
controls.label: Never cache these pages
controls.placeholder: Search pages or type a path, like /members/*
controls.help: Pick a page or type a path. A * at the end covers everything under it.
controls.tooltip: Type a path starting with /. Use * at the end to include everything under it, for example /courses/*. Full web addresses and other wildcards aren't accepted.
controls.validation_error: Enter a path that starts with /, such as /members/ or /members/*.
controls.ai_description: List of post IDs and path prefixes. Prefix match only; trailing * allowed; no regex.

controls.visibility: In page settings for users who can edit the page
controls.label: Don't cache this page
controls.help: Turn on if this page shows different content to each visitor.
controls.tooltip: Use for pages with a booking calendar, live stock, a members-only area, or anything personal. UiChemy already detects most of these automatically.
controls.ai_description: Per-post override stored as post meta through the performance policy service. Requires edit_post on that post.

controls.label: Skip visitors with these cookies
controls.placeholder: Type a cookie name, like my_plugin_session
controls.help: Visitors carrying one of these cookies always get a fresh page.
controls.tooltip: Login, cart, password and comment cookies are already handled, along with cookies from WooCommerce, Easy Digital Downloads and the other plugins listed under Detected plugins.
controls.validation_error: Use letters, numbers, dashes and underscores only.
controls.ai_description: Additional cookie-name prefixes that force BYPASS. Cannot remove built-in or rule-pack cookies.

controls.label: Ignore tracking parameters
controls.help: Links with "?utm_source=newsletter" don't change the page, so they get the cached copy.
controls.tooltip: Tracking links add text such as ?utm_source=newsletter to the address. These don't change the page, so UiChemy serves the normal cached copy. Your analytics still sees the parameters, because they stay in the browser address.
controls.ai_description: Query parameter names (trailing * allowed) that are ignored when reading the cache. Requests with these parameters never write cache entries.

controls.label: When content changes, clear

choices.label: The changed page and related pages
choices.hint: For example, a new post clears itself, the home page, its categories and the blog page.

choices.label: The whole cache
choices.hint: Simplest. Use if pages show content from many other pages.

controls.help: Menus, headers, footers, templates and global styles always clear the whole cache.
controls.tooltip: Clearing only removes the saved copies. Pages are rebuilt the next time someone visits, or by preload if you have Pro.
controls.ai_description: Invalidation strategy for post-level changes. Global changes always invalidate all.

controls.label: Preload pages
controls.help: Re-caches cleared and expiring pages in the background, so visitors always get a cached copy.
controls.tooltip: UiChemy visits your pages itself, as a logged-out visitor. After a clear it rebuilds the cleared pages; between clears it rebuilds pages shortly before they expire, and the phone copy too when that is on.
controls.locked_text: Preload is part of UiChemy Pro. Without it, pages rebuild when the first visitor arrives.
controls.ai_description: Enables background warming of cleared URLs, then sitemap URLs after a full clear.

controls.label: Preload speed
controls.help: Faster finishes sooner, but puts more load on your server.
controls.tooltip: Each preloaded page uses the same server work as one visitor. A 1,000-page site takes about 85 minutes at Normal speed.
controls.ai_description: Maximum warm requests per minute. Adaptive back-off halves the rate when median build time doubles.

controls.visibility: Always visible (locked for Free); expanded when Cloudflare is detected
controls.label: API token
controls.help: Needs only the Zone → Cache Purge permission.
controls.tooltip: In Cloudflare, go to My Profile → API Tokens → Create Token, and give it only the Zone → Cache Purge permission for this site. UiChemy stores the token on your server and never shows it again.
controls.connected: Connected to {zone}. Cloudflare is cleared along with UiChemy's cache.
controls.locked_text: Cloudflare clearing is part of UiChemy Pro.
controls.ai_description: Write-only secret. Reads return masked value and connection status only.

cdn_note.text: Media CDN settings (D01–D04) keep the copy already written in ui-review/controls.csv. Only change: D01–D04 become Pro, and saving or turning off the CDN clears the page cache.
cdn_note.cdn_change_notice: CDN settings changed. The page cache was cleared so pages use the new addresses.

actions.label: Clear cache
actions.success: Cache cleared. Pages will rebuild as visitors arrive.
actions.success_with_preload: Cache cleared. Preload is rebuilding {count} pages.
actions.error: The cache couldn't be cleared because the cache folder isn't writable. Ask your host to make wp-content/uichemy writable by WordPress.

actions.label: Clear this page
actions.location: Admin bar, on the front end
actions.success: This page was cleared from the cache.

actions.label: Run test
actions.running: Testing your home page as a logged-out visitor…
actions.pass: Working. Your home page loaded in {cached_ms} ms from the cache, compared with {uncached_ms} ms without it.
actions.pass_host: Working. {host} served your home page from its cache.
actions.fail_no_loopback: UiChemy couldn't visit your own site to run the test. This usually means a firewall or a password-protected staging site. The cache may still work; check it in a private browser window.
actions.fail_unknown: The test didn't finish. Try again, and if it fails twice, use Ask AI to check the details.

actions.label: Test
actions.location: Performance → Page cache → Page status; editor page settings
actions.result_hit: Cached. Visitors get the saved copy.
actions.result_miss: Not cached yet. It will be saved on the next visit.

detected_plugins.title: Detected plugins
detected_plugins.intro: UiChemy found these plugins and applies safe rules for them automatically.
detected_plugins.empty: No plugins that need special handling were found.

packs.line: Cart, checkout and account pages are never cached. Visitors with items in their cart always get a fresh page. Product pages clear when stock or price changes.
Checkout and purchase confirmation pages are never cached. Visitors with items in their cart always get a fresh page.
Checkout, customer dashboard and account pages are never cached.
Pages with a booking form from {plugin} are never cached, so availability is always current.
Pages with a Gravity Forms form are never cached, as Gravity Forms recommends.
Pages with forms are cached and refreshed within 10 hours, so form security tokens stay valid.
Pages with a payment form are never cached.
Account, login, checkout and member-only pages from {plugin} are never cached.
Visitors arriving through an affiliate link always get a fresh page, so the referral is recorded.
Each language is cached separately using its own address. Pages that change language without changing the address aren't cached.
No change needed. Consent banners work with cached pages.

editor.save_toast: Saved. The cached copy of this page was cleared.

notices.title: Another cache plugin is active
notices.body: {plugin} is already set up to cache pages. Two page caches can show visitors old content, so UiChemy's cache stays off. To use UiChemy instead, deactivate {plugin} and then turn UiChemy's cache on.
notices.body_unknown: Another plugin has already set up page caching on this site, so UiChemy's cache stays off.

notices.title: One manual step needed
notices.body: UiChemy can't edit wp-config.php on this server. Add this line above the line that says "That's all, stop editing!", then click Check again.
notices.code: define( 'WP_CACHE', true ); // Added for UiChemy page cache

notices.when: Host page cache detected on first visit
notices.title: {host} already caches your pages
notices.body: UiChemy will leave page caching to {host} and clear the {host} cache when you save pages. You don't need to change anything.

notices.title: Page cache can't save files
notices.body: WordPress can't write to {folder}. Pages are still served normally, just without the cache. Ask your host to make this folder writable by WordPress.

notices.title: Cache is full
notices.body: The cache reached its limit of {limit}. The oldest pages are being removed automatically. If this happens often, your site may have many pages with unusual addresses; Ask AI can check why.

notices.title: Not available on multisite
notices.body: UiChemy's page cache works on single WordPress sites only. Use your host's cache or a multisite-ready cache plugin.

notices.title: Couldn't connect to Cloudflare
notices.body_invalid_token: Cloudflare rejected the token. Check that you copied all of it.
notices.body_permission: The token doesn't have permission to clear the cache. Create a token with Zone → Cache Purge for this site.
notices.body_zone: This token can't access the Cloudflare zone for {domain}. Check that the token covers this site.
notices.body_network: UiChemy couldn't reach Cloudflare from your server. Try again in a few minutes.
notices.body_zone_other: The token works, but it covers {zones}, not {domain}. Create a token for {domain}.
notices.body_local: Cloudflare can't sit in front of a local site ({domain}). Connect it on your live site.

notices.when: Host cache detected but cannot be cleared by UiChemy
notices.title: Clear the {host} cache yourself
notices.body: {host} caches your pages, but doesn't let plugins clear that cache. After big changes, clear it from your {host} dashboard. Small edits refresh on their own within {host_ttl}.
notices.body_no_ttl: {host} caches your pages, but doesn't let plugins clear that cache. After big changes, clear it from your {host} dashboard.

notices.when: Shown under "Test cache" after a test that passed
notices.title: Page cache is on
notices.body: Your home page now loads in {cached_ms} ms from the cache, compared with {uncached_ms} ms before.

notices.title: Preloading pages
notices.body: {done} of {total} pages rebuilt. Your site works normally while this runs.

reasons.label: you're logged in
reasons.explanation: Logged-in users always get a fresh page, so they see their own account details and the admin bar.
reasons.fix: Check the page in a private browser window to see what visitors get.

reasons.label: the visitor has a {cookie} cookie
reasons.explanation: This cookie means the page may be personal, for example a cart or a session from {plugin}.
reasons.fix: Nothing to fix. Visitors without this cookie get the cached page.

reasons.label: the address contains ?{param}
reasons.explanation: Addresses with extra parameters can show different content, so they're built fresh each time.
reasons.fix: If {param} is only for tracking, add it under Ignore these link parameters.

reasons.label: it's a form submission
reasons.explanation: Only normal page views are cached. Form submissions always go to WordPress.
reasons.fix: Nothing to fix.

reasons.label: you excluded it
reasons.explanation: This page is in "Never cache these pages", or "Don't cache this page" is on.
reasons.fix: Remove it from the list if it should be cached.

reasons.label: {plugin} needs it fresh
reasons.explanation: {plugin} shows personal or live content on this page.
reasons.fix: Nothing to fix. This protects your visitors.

reasons.label: it contains a {component}
reasons.explanation: Pages with a {component} must always be current, so they aren't cached.
reasons.fix: If the {component} doesn't change between visitors, you can move it to its own page so the rest of the site stays cached.

reasons.label: a plugin asked not to cache it
reasons.explanation: {plugin} told WordPress this page must not be cached.
reasons.fix: Nothing to fix. Contact {plugin} if you think this page should be cached.

reasons.label: the page sets a cookie
reasons.explanation: A page that sets a cookie is usually personal, so saving it could show one visitor's data to another.
reasons.fix: Ask AI to find which plugin sets {cookie}.

reasons.label: the page is marked private
reasons.explanation: WordPress or a plugin sent a header saying this page must not be stored.
reasons.fix: Nothing to fix unless the page should be public.

reasons.label: the page returned an error ({status})
reasons.explanation: Only working pages are cached. Error and redirect pages are always built fresh.
reasons.fix: Fix the error and the page will be cached on the next visit.

reasons.label: it isn't a web page
reasons.explanation: Files, feeds and data responses aren't cached.
reasons.fix: Nothing to fix.

reasons.label: it's password protected
reasons.explanation: Password-protected content is never cached.
reasons.fix: Nothing to fix.

reasons.label: it's a preview
reasons.explanation: Previews and editor views are never cached.
reasons.fix: Nothing to fix.

reasons.label: it's a search results page
reasons.explanation: Search results depend on what each visitor types, so they're built fresh.
reasons.fix: Nothing to fix.

reasons.label: it's a WordPress system address
reasons.explanation: Admin, login, REST API, AJAX and cron addresses are never cached.
reasons.fix: Nothing to fix.

reasons.label: it was requested with a different domain
reasons.explanation: UiChemy only saves pages requested with your site address, {site_host}.
reasons.fix: If this site uses more than one domain, Ask AI to check your settings.

reasons.label: the page cache is off
reasons.explanation: Page cache is set to Off.
reasons.fix: Turn it on in Performance → Page cache.

reasons.label: {host} handles caching
reasons.explanation: {host} caches this page, not UiChemy.
reasons.fix: Nothing to fix.

reasons.label: the cache folder isn't writable
reasons.explanation: WordPress can't save files to {folder}.
reasons.fix: Ask your host to make the folder writable by WordPress.

reasons.label: the cache is full
reasons.explanation: The cache reached its size limit and is removing older pages.
reasons.fix: Ask AI to check whether unusual addresses are filling the cache.

reasons.label: it's being saved right now
reasons.explanation: Another visitor's request is saving this page at this moment.
reasons.fix: Nothing to fix. The next visit gets the cached copy.

reasons.label: this is a multisite network
reasons.explanation: UiChemy's page cache works on single sites only.
reasons.fix: Use your host's cache.

reasons.label: this isn't the page's own address
reasons.explanation: WordPress showed this page at a different spelling of its address, such as capital letters. Only the page's own address is cached, so clearing always reaches it.
reasons.fix: Nothing to fix. Visitors who use the page's own address get the cached copy.

reasons.label: the page changes per visitor
reasons.explanation: The page told browsers it differs by {detail}, so one shared copy could be wrong for someone.
reasons.fix: If the page is the same for everyone, turn off the setting in your theme or plugin that sends this header.

reasons.label: the page changes on phones
reasons.explanation: Your theme or a plugin shows different HTML on phones, and the cache keeps one copy for every device.
reasons.fix: Turn on "Separate copy for mobile" in Performance → Page cache.

ability_descriptions.cache-status: Shows whether a page is cached, by UiChemy or by the host, and why not if it isn't. Accepts a URL on this site or a post ID.
ability_descriptions.cache-test: Requests the home page twice as a logged-out visitor and reports which cache served it and how long it took.
ability_descriptions.cache-clear: Clears cached pages: one page, a list of pages on this site, or everything. Also clears the host and Cloudflare cache when connected.
ability_descriptions.capabilities: Includes the detected host, whether it caches pages, the evidence for that, and the recommended page cache setting.

refusals.safety_rule: Built-in safety rules can't be turned off, because they stop personal pages from being shown to other visitors. You can add exclusions, but not remove these.
refusals.logged_in_cache: UiChemy never caches pages for logged-in users.
refusals.foreign_dropin: Another plugin owns page caching on this site. Deactivate it first; UiChemy won't overwrite its files.
refusals.token_read: The Cloudflare token can't be read back. Only its last four characters are shown.
